description: Search properties currently for sale in Iceland. Every filter is optional; results come 24 to a page, with total (first page only) and nextCursor for the next page.

areaIds.description: Area IDs from find_areas; matches listings inside any of them

cursor.description: nextCursor from the previous page, for the next one

includePriceOnRequest.description: Include listings without an asking price (offers invited); default true

listedWithinDays.description: Only properties on the market for at most this many days

maxPricePerM2.description: Maximum asking price per m² in ISK

maxYear.description: Built in this year or earlier

minYear.description: Built in this year or later

nearby.description: Each result must have a place of this kind within this straight-line distance

sort.description: Result order; default newest on the market first

text.description: Free text matched against street address, town and region, or a 3-digit postcode

types.description: Property types; any of them matches

name: search_properties
title: Search properties for sale
